consent_bank: I agree to share this bank account so the app can store it (encrypted) and show it on tuition notices sent to parents.
consent_student: I agree to share this student's and parent's personal data so the app can store it (encrypted), and I confirm the parent has given permission.
consent_import: I agree to share the personal data of the students in this list so the app can store it (encrypted), and I confirm their parents have given permission.
consent_register: I agree that the app stores and processes my personal data (name, username) and the data I enter to manage my teaching.
register_username_hint: Avoid using your phone number as your username.
consent_required: Please tick the consent box before saving.
privacy_collect_body: Teacher accounts (username, full name, hashed password), the bank account for tuition, student and parent details entered by teachers (name, grade, phone, notes), schedules, attendance and tuition.
privacy_purpose_body: Only to manage schedules, attendance and tuition, and to create tuition notices and parent pages. We do not sell data, show ads, or share it with third parties other than our hosting providers (Vercel, Neon, servers in Singapore).
privacy_protect_body: Personal fields are encrypted with AES-256 in the database, passwords are hashed with bcrypt, and all traffic uses HTTPS. Each teacher can only see their own data; administrators only see plan information.
privacy_teacher_body: Only enter student data with the parent's permission. Do not share parent links publicly. Keep backup files private.
privacy_delete_body: Data is kept while your account is active. Data you delete goes to the trash. To delete it permanently or close your account, contact {contact}.
privacy_summary_store: your account and the student, schedule and tuition data you enter.
privacy_summary_protect: names, phone numbers and bank account numbers are encrypted; nobody can read your password.
privacy_summary_who: only you. Admins only see plan information. No selling, no ads.
privacy_summary_delete: deleted data goes to the trash; to erase it or close your account, contact {contact}.
backup_confirm_desc: The file contains all personal data of students, parents and your bank account, unencrypted. Keep it somewhere safe, do not send it via chat apps or email, and delete it when no longer needed.
billing_change_note: Effective from month {m}/{y}; previous months unchanged.
payos_benefit: Parents scan the QR on the notice; when the money arrives the app records the payment and marks it paid, no need to check bank statements and mark by hand.
payos_cost_note: Using payOS: 100 free transactions for life + 500 free for 6 months; for more (1,000 transactions/year) you need payOS's Pro plan, about 2,000 VND per transaction ≈ 2 million VND/year. If you don't need auto-marking, keep using VietQR, free for life as usual.
payos_help: To set up payOS, follow the {guide} or contact the admin directly:

payos_disconnect_confirm: Disconnect payOS? payOS QR codes already sent will be cancelled and notices go back to VietQR.

tour_close_dialog_first: Close the open window, then tap Show me again.
tour_target_missing: The item to show is not on this page.
tour_need_session_body: Create a session first, then come back to take attendance.
tour_need_student_body: Add a student first, then come back to collect fees.
tour_student_1_body: Tap this button to open the add student form.
tour_student_2_body: Enter the student's name and pick a grade. Both are required.
tour_student_3_body: Per session: based on attended sessions. Monthly: a fixed fee each month. Enter the fee just below.
tour_student_4_body: Parent phone and name are optional, you can add them later.
tour_student_5_body: Tick the data consent box, then tap Add.
tour_import_1_body: Tap the arrow next to Add student.
tour_import_2_body: Choose Import Excel to add a whole list at once.
tour_import_3_body: Download the template and fill one student per row.
tour_import_4_body: Pick the filled file. A preview appears with error rows in red; tick consent, then import.
tour_import_5_body: No list yet? Open this to create a Google Form for parents, then import the responses file.
tour_session_1_body: Tap this button to create a new session.
tour_session_2_body: Pick the session date and subject.
tour_session_3_body: Pick start and end time. The app warns about overlapping sessions.
tour_session_4_body: Pick the students in this session.
tour_session_5_body: Tap Create session to save. For weekly sessions, use the Repeat button on the Calendar page.
tour_attendance_1_body: Tap a session on the calendar to open it and take attendance.
tour_attendance_2_body: Tap the arrow buttons or press ← → to move to the previous or next session this month. Then tap Next.
tour_attendance_3_body: Tap the check if the student attended, the X if absent.
tour_attendance_5_body: Tap Save attendance. Per session fees follow this attendance.
tour_tuition_1_body: The month you just finished is open. Use the arrows to change month.
tour_tuition_2_body: Each row is a student, showing the amount due including earlier debt.
tour_tuition_3_body: Parent paid everything? Tap this. Tapped by mistake? Use Undo on the notice.
tour_tuition_4_body: Create a fee notice with a QR code to send to parents.
tour_tuition_5_body: Tap a student to open fee details.
tour_tuition_6_body: Paid less or for several months: tap Partial payment and enter the amount.
tour_bank_1_body: Type to search for the bank that receives fees.
tour_bank_3_body: Enter the account holder name exactly as in your banking app.
tour_bank_4_body: Tick consent and tap Save. Fee notices will show a transfer QR code.
tour_load_error: Could not load the guide, please try again.
